description: This class contains unit tests for the ProgramWorkflowService in the OpenMRS project, focusing on methods related to patient programs, program workflows, states, conversions, and related entities. It tests CRUD operations, state transitions, Uuids, ordering, and validation logic, primarily for the ProgramWorkflowService implementation.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ProgramWorkflowService covering CRUD, state transitions, UUID retrievals, ordering, and validation in the OpenMRS context. Extends BaseContextSensitiveTest for database integration.
